## Motion.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `as` :: The element to render.
- `initial` :: The starting motion values, applied instantly before the first spring.
- `animate` :: The resting motion values. Reactive: a change springs from the current position, keeping velocity.
- `whileHover` :: Motion values applied while the pointer hovers the element.
- `whilePress` :: Motion values applied while the element is pressed, by pointer or by Enter/Space.
- `whileFocus` :: Motion values applied while the element or a descendant has focus.
- `whileInView` :: Motion values applied while the element is in view. When set, the element stays at `initial` until it enters the viewport.
- `spring` :: The spring used for every state change.
- `delay` :: Delay in milliseconds before the first spring (and before `whileInView` enters). Hover, press and focus are immediate.
- `onAnimationEnd` :: Called when a spring settles, is stopped, or is taken over by a newer one.
- `children` :: The content the motion values act on; it is drawn inside every animated state.
